audit.report: The month-end close job inventory_month_end_close (pid 999093) blocked checkout while idle in transaction (last statement SELECT 1, locks held for 4.2s). Checkout deteriorated from 55% success over 15s to 0% over 30s (120/120 failed) with $18,400/min revenue at risk, exceeding the 60-second business tolerance. The Database Guardian initially proposed waiting, then termination, but the Continuity Guardian required a change-calendar check that revealed active consult_owner window CHG-4410 covering the job. Per invariant I3, unilateral termination was blocked, forcing escalation to the finance-ops owner after 301.9 seconds. The business did not recover; the action was escalated but not executed.
audit.root_cause: The inventory_month_end_close job held locks idle while an active consult_owner change calendar (CHG-4410) prevented termination, and the 301.9-second escalation exceeded the 60-second checkout degradation tolerance.
lessons: Pre-register change calendar CHG-4410 in the workload registry for inventory_month_end_close so guardians can see consult_owner policy before proposing termination, avoiding the round-trip probe that added ~150s.

Define a degradation-budget threshold (e.g., 30s at 0% checkout success) that triggers automatic escalation bypass for inventory_month_end_close when revenue at risk exceeds $1M, since waiting for owner consultation exceeds the 60s business tolerance.
audit.negotiation_critique: The Database Guardian wasted Round 1 proposing 'wait' without checking the change calendar, forcing a revision when the Continuity Guardian correctly flagged missing I2 evidence; the Continuity Guardian properly enforced the consult_owner invariant (I3) that overrode termination.
follow_ups: Finance-ops owner to confirm whether inventory_month_end_close (CHG-4410) can be terminated during Q4 close or if checkout degradation must be tolerated.
Update workload registry for batch_replayable_month_end_close to include change calendar reference CHG-4410 and consult_owner policy.
Review whether the 95-minute replay cost for inventory_month_end_close can be reduced (e.g., checkpointing) to make termination less costly.
